fn RemoveElement(lst: List[Int], target: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires forall x in lst: (x >= 0)
  requires (target >= 0)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] != target)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): exists j in 0..len(lst): ((lst[j] == result[i]) and (lst[j] != target))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(lst): forall j in (i + 1)..len(lst): ((not ((lst[i] != target) and (lst[j] != target))) or (exists k1 in 0..len(result): exists k2 in (k1 + 1)..len(result): ((result[k1] == lst[i]) and (result[k2] == lst[j]))))
  ensures forall x in result: (x >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (RemoveElement([], 0) == [])
{
  []
}
